- acme_vpc_diagram_v2.pdf (single-page control/data plane diagram, customer CIDRs and hostnames redacted)

What this package shows (one-paragraph summary):
Redwood's Private offering places the serving data plane inside the customer's VPC (customer-controlled subnets) while the optional control plane remains in a customer-dedicated private control plane managed by Redwood. Network segregation is enforced via tenant-scoped routing, security groups, and per-customer NAT/egress controls. The attached diagram highlights the only supported egress path and control-plane APIs that are reachable across the peering link. Flow logs and conntrack samples are provided with IPs replaced by stable aliases and timestamps shifted; CAIQ mapping points to the exact files and internal runbooks used for redaction.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether you need any of the artifacts delivered under an NDA or via a secure upload mechanism. If you'd like a short walkthrough, Stephanie and I can hop on a 30-min call this week to go through the diagram and mapping.
